name: threads-scraper
title: Threads Scraper — Bulk Profile Posts (No Login, No API)
description:
Posts from any Threads profile: text, author, ISO timestamps, engagement metrics, media URLs. Up to 100 handles, relative-date filters. Pure HTTP — no login, no API token. $0.0025/result.
⚠️ Custom-feed mode unavailable: Threads serves feeds only to logged-in clients.
